name: Chief Minister Agriculture and Food Processing Scheme
nodalDept: Contact the official scheme portal for details
targetBeneficiaries: Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in agro and food processing
Individuals seeking skill development in agro and food processing
Entrepreneurs aiming for agro and food processing units
briefDescription: This scheme encourages technology-based projects, enhances agricultural produce quality, and boosts exports. It also focuses on creating skilled manpower and employment via small and medium agro-food processing units in rural areas.
descriptionMd:
The Chief Minister Agriculture and Food Processing Scheme in Maharashtra aims to modernize the agriculture and food processing sector. It promotes the adoption of model technology and quality improvements for agricultural produce to enhance market competitiveness and encourage exports.

The scheme also focuses on human capital development by creating skilled manpower for the agro and food processing industry. Furthermore, it seeks to generate employment through the establishment and growth of small and medium agro and food processing units, particularly in rural areas.
benefitsMd:
- Encourage model technology-based projects and quality enhancement of agriculture produce.
- Promote exports of agricultural and processed food products.
- Create skilled manpower for the agro and food processing sector.
- Generate employment through the establishment and support of small and medium agro and food processing units in rural areas.
eligibilityMd: Contact the official scheme portal or nodal department for detailed eligibility criteria.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
